column3: main(argc,argv): parse command line, hardware checks, load resources, run the game-mode state machine, shut down and exit
Start of mission: view mode 7 (insertion camera), orbit distance 0x264, show 'Insertion' for 0x800 ticks, insertion craft leaves at g_time+0xA00, Point Man MOVER+0x3A (exhaustion) = 4
End of insertion: normal first-person then chase view (mode 2), refresh scenery, orbit distance 0xC0, show 'Insertion craft clear.' for 0x200 ticks
Begin extraction (once, not in camp worlds): view mode 8, orbit distance 0x120, show 'Extraction' 0x1D00 ticks, mission end at g_time+0x1D00, pick and start the end music (6..10), set g_extracting
Time compression off (if on): clear message queue, resync raw ticks to g_time, force full redraw
Time compression on (if off): g_tc_state=3, clear message queue, queue 'Time Compression On' (0x7800 ticks)
Load and play one mission: world/team setup, per-frame render + input + timed AI/sound/scenery updates until extraction completes or quit; returns 1 if the player quit the game (Alt-X)
After a mission: free world objects, effect pools, projectiles, 3D data (45A6), stop mission sounds (4592:07D5) and free the mission data (365E:24BC)
Empty function called when the mission loop ends
Music mood for the current moment: 2 = combat (g_time < contact timer DS:0898), 1 = alert (g_time < DS:D808), else 0 (always 0 when music mode DS:45CE == 2)
Every 1.25 s: switch the background music track to the current mood (tracks 0..2), or wait for sting tracks 3/4 to finish first

Every 1.25 s: when not already alerted and an enemy is detected show 'Enemy sighted.' (+ leader 'Enemy' hand signal after 40 s of quiet) and stay alerted 0x1400 ticks; announce 'Radio repaired.' when the repair time passes
Draw the 90-degree heading tape (x 0x45..0xF9, 2 px per degree) under the top of the 3D view: ticks every 5/15 degrees, labels every 30 (N, 30, 60, E ...), centre marker
Draw the objective bearing marker on the compass tape (caret under its degree column, or '<'/'>' at the tape edge when outside the 90-degree window); hidden within 15 units of the objective
Draw the 16x16 target diamond at (x,y) in the range-band colour and the range text '((range/3)>>2) m' under it, clipped to the 3D view
Number (0..3) of the weapon's three range thresholds (weapon table +8/+0xA/+0xC) that are <= the given range
First-person HUD: diamond, name (object type name, or team type name + fire-team letter) and ' Objective' tag for the current target at the reticle position (DS:0534/0536)
Keep the weapon/tool HUD lines visible for 0x200 ticks (sets their three end times)
Bottom-of-view HUD text: demolition countdown, tool and ammo, primary weapon rounds/fire mode, current item, team order, 'Reloading ...' and 'Detail Level: n'
If the weapon has reloads left, set *end = g_time + (difficulty 'reload timed' ? weapon reload ticks (table +0x1E) : 0x40)
Empty function called after the first-person HUD
Time-compression display: clear a small box and draw the 'hh:mm:ss' clock (map screen at (0xE0,3), else under the 3D view)
Set the time of day (hour, minute); seconds = (g_time>>8) mod 60; restart the minute timer
Add (hours, minutes) to the time of day with one wrap correction each (60 min, 24 h)
Advance the time of day by one minute each time 0x3C00 ticks (60 s) have passed; recompute seconds
Palette/sky selection for the current hour: 0 pal2 (day 09-17), 1 paln (night 21-04), 2 pals (dawn 05-08 / dusk 18-20); also sets the sky/ground gradient offsets DS:0530/0532
Fill the 3D view with the sky and ground gradients (gradsky1/gradgrn1 lookup, per-row at detail>=2 else record flat colours) and brighten the dawn gradient every 0xF00 ticks
Fill the current view rectangle with ground colour gradgrn1[0xB6] (map screen background)
Fill the current view rectangle with colour 0x12 (used by front-end screens 365E)
Load full-screen picture n (0 mapscr,1 title,2 brf,3 pwo,4 mainm,5 intel,7 debrf,9 load,10-13 new..new4,14-19 cm0..cm5,20 ea) + '.pic' into the picture buffer DS:0526
(not in Ghidra function list) Free the picture buffer DS:0526 (2255:28CA) and set DS:0524 = 0xFF; no callers found
Copy a rectangle {x,y,w,h} from the picture buffer DS:0526 to the draw page (pascal)
Copy the whole screen (rect DS:4F94) from the draw page into the picture buffer DS:0526 (used by 365E:A940)
Copy a rectangle from the displayed page to the current draw page (pascal)
Set the clip rect to 320x200, flip the video pages and restart the frame limiter
page_copy_rect for the whole screen (DS:4F94)
Mission start: eye height, normal view, map setup (19AC:2E69), clear all HUD/demo/radio timers, objective bearing, camera distances 0xC0, sky offsets 0, enemy-view index -1
Draw one frame for the current view mode: banners/map background on full redraws, sky/ground or map fill, 3D world, HUD text, message box, compass/target overlays, 3D sound listener update
Initialise a camera struct: x,z,y = args<<8, pitch = arg<<3, yaw/roll 0, screen rect, field +0x1A = 8
Create the three cameras: main 3D (0,8,320x171), map (8,10,204x155, pitch -90, height 1000) and small 3D (0,24,320x139); current = main
Switch to the map camera (remember the previous 3D mode in DS:EC52 if 0 or 2), copy the main camera x/z, map setup (19AC:2FE8), mode 1, full redraw, flat colours unset
View mode 0 (point man's eyes, main camera), full redraw, refresh scenery, hide markers, show weapon lines
View mode 2 (chase camera behind the point man, small camera), refresh scenery, hide markers, show weapon lines
F3-F8: view from support team ec8c+n (modes 3,4,0xF,0x10; team kind must be 1..3) or, for n=4/5, the last teams (modes 0x11,0x12, needs DS:EC9C); returns 0 if not available
Set view mode n (0xC = map-style reinsertion view via view_enter_map, others use the small camera), full redraw, hide markers
F9: view mode 0xD (camera on the current target) when the target is a unit
Set the main camera height from the point man's posture/stance fields (soldier +0x18, +0x26 bit 0x40)
If a team's camera angle (+0x32) is -1 set it to the raw bearing from the Point Man to the team leader
Position the current camera for view mode n (first person, map, chase/orbit around a unit or craft, insertion/extraction orbit); updates 3D sound listener position
F10 enemy view: advance DS:053C to the next VC/NVA team (index DS:EC8F+n, wraps at team count DS:EC87) whose leader is dead or whose AI flag +0x6C bit7 is set
Wait 0x180 ticks, draw the 'One Moment Please ...' box and present it
Joystick calibration: fill the prompt area (0x20,0x51,256x33, colour 0x14) and draw two centred text lines at y 0x58 and 0x62
Show a corner prompt, wait for fire button (Esc aborts), average 16 stick readings 8 ticks apart, wait for release, pause 0x80 ticks; returns 1 on success
Joystick calibration dialog ('JOYSTICK CALIBRATION', upper-left, lower-right, centre) on a single video page; returns 0 if Esc turned the joystick off
g_time = 0 and, once, install the 256 Hz timer callback (4A1C) via the sound driver (4592:0BCB)
Remove the 256 Hz timer callback if it was installed
g_time = raw 256 Hz tick count; g_frame_ticks = ticks since last update (min 1)
Time compression step: g_time += 0x80 (0.5 s) per call; g_frame_ticks accordingly
Set the raw tick counter to g_time (after time compression)
Save g_time (pause)
If a saved time exists, restore g_time and the raw ticks from it and clear the saved value
g_time = raw ticks = 0, g_frame_ticks = 1, no saved time
Busy-wait n ticks (updating g_time)
Ray query (4FF8:0148, step 0x1000) from a position to a world object; returns hit id or 0 (pascal)
Short ray query from an object's position to +0x600 in x and z; returns hit id or 0 (pascal)
Copy the 12-byte position (x,y,z longs at +6) of a 3D object to a buffer
Approximate ground distance between two positions: (max + 3*min/8) >> 8 of |dx|,|dz| (clamped to 0x7FFF)
(unit object y - reference height +0x2C of the unit's near record) >> 8 (no callers found)
Bearing in degrees (0..359) from position A to B (atan2 >> 3); 0 if same pointer
Elevation angle in degrees from position A to B (2255:64FD >> 3)
Combine two 1/8-degree headings into a 0..359 relative bearing ((180 - a/8) + b/8 mod 360)

Among the three mission point slots (mission +0x76/+0xD8/+0x13A == 3, object index at slot +0x10) pick one within 3000 units of a unit (last match wins), else world object 0; returns 1 if a slot matched
Like wld_find_mission_point but the object must have hit points > 0; fallback = the world object nearest to the Point Man
Index of the nearest world object of a kind (-1 any; kind 7 also matches 9) within 24000 units, or -1
Set/clear the visible bit of all kind-5 world objects (used around collision probes)
Place the probe object at a position and ray-probe it; returns 1 if it hits a world object of the given kind (-1 any, 5 = include hidden kind-5 objects)
Write the midpoint of two positions (x, y, z)
Add the same offset (<<8) to x and z of a position into an output position
Move a position by a random x/z offset (bounded by two limits) and pull it back if it lands in water (kinds 7/9)
Return 2 if a position is on water (kinds 7, 8 or 9), else 1 (1 also for a NULL position)
Random tree/bush shape id from the object type table (entries 7 or 0x54)
Random ground-cover object type 0x27..0x2F by a cascade of random tests
Configure a distant scenery object (random heading, type 0x51/0x52/0x53 or large tree 0x37/0x38 with smoke) based on distance and chance
True if the bearing from A to B lies within +-halfangle (max 180) of heading h (degrees)
Convert a ray hit id ((id-2)/0x18 record index) to the world object far pointer, or 0
Line-of-sight obstruction from a unit to a position: sum of the cover bytes of the world objects crossed (stops at a total >= 100, when nothing new is hit or the target is reached)
Probe at a unit's position and convert the hit to an object index (19AC:622C)
World object at a unit's position if it is solid (height byte >= 0x7F) or water/hut kind (7,8,9,0xA,0xB,0x11), else 0
Load '<world>.w' (18-byte records) into the world object table DS:26F4 (max 524), load '<world>.wd' into DS:ECB8, then append 126 spare objects (DS:31BA)
Allocate the 32 projectile objects (DS:2670) and the effect object pools (markers, flashes, smoke, trees, ground cover)
Free all world objects and clear the count
Free the 32 projectile objects
Per-mission 3D init, load world n, create pools, create units (365E:129A), finish 3D init, scan special objects
Free units, projectiles, world objects and the per-mission 3D data
Clear the state of all projectiles (flags, owner, weapon) and re-init moving ones
Find the active projectile that owns a given effect object (fields +0x40..+0x4E)
First object of a NULL-terminated pool whose 3D instance is not visible (free), or 0
Hide an effect object (clear visible bit of +2)
First wrapper in a pool whose 3D instance exists and is not visible
Take a free projectile slot (0..31) and set its shape from the weapon class and fire mode; returns slot index (32 = none)
Fire a weapon: jam check, projectile setup (owner, weapon, target, times, lifetime/speed, demolition 60 s fuse), firing sound burst, muzzle height and aim angles
Release a projectile's effect objects, mark it inactive and hide it
Shape id for a destroyed world object by kind (0x791A special, 0x8800 kind 6, 0x786A kind 0, 0x79B0 kind 3, else 0x7A40)
Fire the phantom unit's weapon (DS:134A) at a target or at its own position to create an explosion
Clear bit0 of a world object's instance byte +3; kind 0xB also sets instance +0x14 = 1
Apply a hit: to a world object (hit points, destruction shape, prisoner release) or to a unit (wound bits, wound/serious-hit counters, radio damage chance, suppressed/wounded/killed handling)
Return 0 if the unit has a projectile (+0x38) whose flags +0x28 have bits 0-2 and 9 clear, else 1
Set flag 0x100 in the unit's active projectile (+0x28) so it stops
Show/hide the single aim marker at an x/z offset rotated by the point man's heading
Show marker n (0..3) 12 units in front of a unit
Show or hide the 4 unit markers and park them at (0x5DC000, 0x5DC000)
Attach/detach a marker object (pool DS:2F94, shape by team size) to all members of a unit's team and place it relative to the unit
Place/remove a projectile's muzzle flash object (pool DS:2F70) at the shooter with posture-dependent height
Place/remove a unit's ground effect object (pool DS:2F2C; shape by move state/terrain flags, ripple via 4E87:0006) while the unit is within 0x4B0 of the camera
Switch a projectile to the 0x7C02 burst shape and play sound 0xF (0x10 for classes 0xF/0x14); grenade-like classes copy +0x1C into the expiry +0x24; n < 0 restores the normal shape
Once: switch a projectile to the 0x7C02 burst shape, expiry = +0x1C, OR impact flags into +0x28, lifetime 0x100 from now, sound 10; n < 0 restores the normal shape
Show the 0x7C02 burst shape on a projectile without sound (n < 0 restores the normal shape)
If a hut/bunker (kind 0xA/0xB) lies within 10 degrees ahead and 0x79 units, set its cover byte to 100 and return 1

Auto-target: first targetable structure (cover byte 100, within 10 deg of the heading and 0x4B0 units, line-of-sight cover < 100, huts only within 0x79), then the first active foot-team unit within 16 deg, closer than 0x475 and than that structure; fills the target record (5149:000E..); returns 0 unit, 1 structure, -1 none
Project a 3D point (object +6,+8,+0xA words) to screen coordinates via 2255:4328
Render callback: find the target's 3D node and project it to the reticle position DS:0534/0536
(not in Ghidra function list) True if bit0 of world object n field +8 is set (called from 365E)
True if world object n has hit points < 1
True if world object n is flagged (+8 bit0) and destroyed or DS:EC94 > 4
True if bit0 of world object n field +8 is set
Minutes since the mission start time (+1)
Number of destroyed kind-0 world objects
True if the current world index is > 27 (camp1..camp5)

Send a radio order to team n: needed for friendly teams or beyond 600 units; fails with 'Radio damaged.'; support teams 1/2 may be busy (retry timer +0x44, 0x1E00); plays radio sounds and shows 'Radio: <text>'; returns 1 if sent
Set flags: world contains object shape 0xC4B2, mission has support type 3 and 2 entries (365E:29C5); then 365E:1E8D
Height (long +8 >> 8) of the DS record referenced by a far pointer's first word, or 150 if none
The second member of the SEAL team fires its current tool (flare/marker) at its own position
Secondary effects when a structure is destroyed: phantom fires weapon 0x21 then 0x1A at it
Load mission sprite banks (fxmu, fxsm, hnds if hand signals on, exsm, exlg, impc) and the Jungle/Bush/impcf1r1/Grass RLE textures
Free the sprite banks and textures loaded by mis_load_sprites
Draw a sprite centred on (x,y)
Draw a sprite with its bottom centre at (x,y) if detail level > 0
Draw a sprite bottom-centred at (x&~7,y), clipped to a size, if detail level >= 4
Draw an explosion/impact sprite frame chosen from the elapsed time of a projectile
Draw a projectile/flare sprite frame (burning flares use the remap table for lighting)
Park and hide all ground-cover, tree and spare objects, reset scenery tracking positions and force regeneration
Place ground-cover objects on a grid pattern (0x31 or 0x62 cells) around the point man, avoiding kind-5 blockers
Place vegetation sprites on a camera-relative pattern (DS:348C..354F, rotated in 90-degree steps) on a 64-unit grid
Place 4 distant tree objects around the camera (pattern DS:3550)
Regenerate scenery when the point man/camera moved far enough (0x8000 / 0x2001 units or 16 degrees), depending on detail level
Draw the animated hand-signal icon (hnds bank) for a style-3 message
Queue a speech line 'name: "text"' (split over two lines if longer than 55 chars); returns text length
Turn time compression off and queue an on-screen HUD message (kind 3, style 2) for n ticks
Turn time compression off and show hand signal n from a unit (icon + text, or text only when hand-signal graphics are off)
Append a message (text, kind, duration, style, sticky) to the 8-entry ring queue DS:3716; returns 0 if full/disabled
Remove message entry n (refused for the last sticky one) and advance the queue head
Remove all removable messages
Return the number of queued messages
Skip the current message (and a following zero-duration one) if more are queued
Start the head message's timer, or expire it (and a following zero-duration one) when its time is up
Draw a full hand-signal picture (kind 4) centred in a box and force a full redraw
Draw the head message (and the next one) according to its kind: HUD line/icon, dialog text or signal picture
Draw the head message while it is on screen and also start/draw the next icon-style message
Empty the message queue and enable messages
Mark all 20 noise events (far 53BA:26DA) free
Index of a free noise event or -1
Create a noise event for a team leader (footsteps/running, wading, vehicle engine, enemy radio chatter) with rand(100)<=level, level reduced by leader stats; 5% chance of a cough/sneeze
Every 4 s: noise_from_team for every team, then age events (first mark heard, next time free them)
Create a weapon noise event (type 0x13, level = weapon table +0x16 * 4, or 6)
Create an explosion noise event (type 0x11, level from far table 525C:0022); no callers found
For a listener unit find the loudest audible noise from the other side (difficulty 'Intelligence' lowers enemy hearing); copy its position; returns 1 if heard
Sum the counts of inventory entries of a type in a unit's item list (+0x1A)
Subtract n from the first inventory entry of a type that has a positive count
